programme.desc: Farmer Clark Davis struggles to repay a loan and save his land during a drought. Making matters worse, his wife becomes gravely ill after agreeing to take a job in order to bring in more income.

programme.desc: In 1930s California, a widowed farmer (Sydney Penny) tries to save her property from being seized by the bank with the help of a kindly drifter, who may be much more than he seems. Based on a novel by Lynn Austin.

programme.desc: A talented equestrian (Andrea Bowen) is paralyzed after an accident and must go through physical therapy in hopes of someday walking again. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.desc: LA cabbie Jamie Foxx unwittingly turns getaway driver when he picks up ruthless hitman Tom Cruise. Thriller from Heat director Michael Mann. Strong language/violence.

programme.title: Italian Job, The
programme.desc: Ex-convict Michael Caine hatches an audacious plan to steal $4 million, involving a bus, two Jaguars and, of course, three Mini Coopers. Comic adventure. Flashing images.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Matt Damon's super-soldier emerges from the shadows when a face from his past uncovers hard-hitting secrets. Action thriller with Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander.

programme.title: Unhinged
programme.desc: A road rage incident becomes something a lot darker for a young woman when she is terrorised by an unstable stranger. Russell Crowe stars.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Audrey Tautou race across Europe in a bid to uncover a secret. Mystery thriller based on the Dan Brown novel. Violence/sex.

programme.title: Swallowed
programme.desc: After a drug run goes bad, two friends must survive a nightmarish ordeal of drugs, bugs and horrific intimacy. Horror. Contains disturbing images.

programme.title: Parallel
programme.desc: Grief-stricken after the loss of her child, Vanessa mysteriously finds herself navigating between parallel spaces. Thrilling sci-fi drama.

programme.title: Barber
programme.desc: Private investigator Val Barber is hired by a wealthy widow to find her missing granddaughter. Mystery drama with Aidan Gillen and Gary Lydon.

programme.title: Machete
programme.desc: Danny Trejo is on a bloody mission of revenge in Robert Rodriguez's grisly grindhouse romp. With Jessica Alba and Robert De Niro. Strong language/violence/flashing images.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: When a nuclear sub malfunctions, captains Harrison Ford and Liam Neeson clash as they battle to avert disaster. Thriller from Kathryn Bigelow. Violence/flashing images.

programme.title: Into The Deep
